summary: Avis Budget Group filed an 8-K reporting an amendment and extension of its asset-backed variable-funding financing facilities (Series 2010-6 and Series 2015-3) through subsidiary Avis Budget Rental Car Funding (AESOP) LLC. The aggregate note amounts increased from ~$2.227B to $2.628B and ~$109M to $132M, respectively, with reductions scheduled for November 1, 2026. The Class A notes have a two-year term, Class B notes a one-year term. This is a routine refinancing of fleet-secured debt, not a special situation.
